_comment: The apply worker's own Railway config. Point the service's config-file
path at worker/railway.json in the dashboard, or it inherits the one at
the repo root -- which sets healthcheckPath /api/health.
That inheritance is what makes a worker deploy fail. This service binds
no port and answers nothing: it polls a table and drives a browser. With
the root config applied, Railway waits for a health endpoint that will
never exist, times out, and reports a crash that has nothing to do with
the code -- which is exactly what it looks like from the logs.
So: no healthcheckPath here, on purpose. The restart policy is kept,
because a worker that dies on a bad row should come back and carry on.
